decision_record.decision: Promote a background-subtracted Born chain to the published correction through its own validation gate (supersedes the critic's minimal-cost option).
decision_record.superseded_option: post-unfold (1-f) multiplicative factor as the published treatment (row-17 'generic post-hoc fraction' prohibition)

what_bgfracsub_does_today.estimator: sigma = cross_section_nb * (1 - f_b) * C_rad on 490 release bins
what_bgfracsub_does_today.f_b: B/D after 980->490 pT-pair summation; B = 0.5*(RG+DJ) generator-averaged templates, var = 0.25*(varRG+varDJ); D = alpha0p2 cone-vetoed data vector
what_bgfracsub_does_today.template_stat_width_term: sigma_B_nb = sqrt(varB) * (sigma_raw/D) * C_rad, added in quadrature
what_bgfracsub_does_today.product_status: PROVISIONAL diagnostics only (xFcut C_rad keys 2026-10-07/08); no releasebin-key products
what_bgfracsub_does_today.verdict: correct dilution-approximation calculator; not a response-consistent subtraction; not publishable as-is

fiducial_adjudication.target_definition: charged hadrons from the DIS event

electrons_nonv0.handling: 100% fake column, removed by response fake fraction

other_unmatched.handling: fake column, removed by response fake fraction

detint.handling: fake-column 13.82% removed by response fake fraction; matched 86.18% response-modeled signal proxy
detint.note: matched-body data-MC mismatch is an uncertainty (bgsub_fakefrac_rel), not a subtraction

v0_daughters.handling: dropped from the response entirely (no fake column, no matched block)

setB_all.reason: double-counts electrons (100% fake column, already removed by response fake fraction)

setA_v0_detint_lowq2.reason: over-subtracts the 13.82% det.int. fake-column slice already removed; blind-subtracts the 86% response-modeled matched body (house rule violation)

allfake_chain.reason: fiducially purest alternative but blast radius forbids: response swap, budget rederivation, selection change, stale blind C_rad sidecars

residual_gaps.gap: alpha0p2 template selection vs central chain
residual_gaps.disposition: bounded residual, carried in bgsub_stage_rel (alpha0p2 width)

residual_gaps.convention: D==0 -> no subtraction, f=0, preserved bit-for-bit

published_scheme.stage: PRE-UNFOLD data-vector subtraction, then the unchanged central chain
published_scheme.response_consistency_rationale: The central response reco space excludes V0-daughter and low-Q2 tracks; the data vector contains them (untaggable). Pre-unfold subtraction restores agreement between the data vector and the response's modeled reco content; a post-unfold (1-f) factor is only a dilution approximation (row-17 prohibition).

subtraction.variance_E1b: var_sub[i] = data_sub[i] + varB_R[i], varB_R = 0.25*(varRG_V0 + varDJ_V0) + var_lowQ2
subtraction.w2_policy: toy/released statistical input is Poisson-only (w2 = data_sub); template variance carried by bgsub_stat_rel (no double-count; retired rev-2 defect = Poisson added twice, data variance x2.00022)

fake_fraction.policy: UNCHANGED central per-bin table, byte-identical (sha256) to the nominal release sidecar
fake_fraction.exactly_once_bookkeeping: electrons + other/unmatched + det.int. fake-column (13.82%) via response f_i; V0 + lowQ2 via explicit subtraction; det.int. matched body (86.18%) in neither

c_rad.policy: applied exactly as in the Born release; bitwise C_rad x raw identity (max dev 0.0)

published_scheme.estimator_per_bin: sigma_bgsub[b] = (1/L) * IBU_k4(data_central - B_R; RG31 response, body+miss prior, fake fraction f_i)[b] * C_rad_releasebin[b]
published_scheme.product: new dated release directory born_crad_bgsub_setR_centralbase_<tag>_<date>; exact-text serialization; README invariants; v4-style validation.json extended with bgsub checks; existing releases untouched

per_bin_treatment.policy: no bin excluded; single 14% bin (h+ global 34, high-z low-pT corner) stays in with full variance and is monitored by name; templates charge-separated

published_scheme.post_unfold_variant_role: cross-check (gate CP-1) and measured input to bgsub_stage_rel; never the published number
published_scheme.allfake_role: diagnostic fallback and exactly-once bookkeeping cross-check; stale blind C_rad sidecars never re-attached

uncertainty_components.decision: NEW components added to the register (13 -> 17); the existing 13 are NOT widened, NOT recomputed, must remain byte-identical to the emfix package
uncertainty_components.rationale: 13-component budget has no background term (row 17 BLOCKED); row 17 reserves this slot; IBU toys stay Poisson-only on data_sub so nothing widens implicitly

components.name: bgsub_stat_rel
components.definition: sqrt(varB_R)/data_sub per release bin (template MC statistics of the subtracted set)
components.class: statistical; NO smoothing, raw per bin

components.name: bgsub_model_rel
components.definition: 0.5*|RG31-DJ14|(V0)/data_sub (per bin) in quadrature with 0.30*lowQ2/data_sub (+/-30% precedent arXiv:1302.1321)
components.class: model; raw half-spread default; house pT-row Gaussian smoothing (sigma=1 bin, edge-truncated renormalised, floor 0.85*unsmoothed) only if sparse-bin spikes fail smoothness QA

components.name: bgsub_stage_rel
components.definition: per-bin |pre-unfold - post-unfold dilution|/published (measured at gate CP-1) in quadrature with the alpha0p2 cone-selection residual bound |f_res_alpha0p2_D - f_res_centralD| (the alpha0p2 width)
components.class: stage/selection coherence; measured at gate time

components.name: bgsub_fakefrac_rel
components.definition: per-bin |1 - r_min|*f_i with r from the G9/S1b template-vs-fakecolumn category ratios; covers model dependence of the response fake fraction (electrons, other/unmatched, det.int. fake column incl. the 86/18 partition model)
components.class: common-model; re-derive r with NucliaWeight caveat resolved at gate, or carry the caveat

uncertainty_components.quoting_policy: after gate PASS the published total is the 17-component quadrature; the 13-component total is no longer quoted as published
uncertainty_components.rows_18_19_status: diffvm_rel and gammap_bkg_30pct_rel remain BLOCKED, unchanged by this spec

validation_gate.model: allfake G0-G10 ledger + Born release validation.json v4 invariants
validation_gate.rule: ALL items must PASS before promotion; no merge into nominal until PASS (state rule)

integrated sums of B_R and data_sub

PM_promotion_mechanics.check: P-ALPHA closed or explicitly waived in release README with bounded cone-residual argument and resulting bgsub_stage_rel width; alpha0p2 products' PROVISIONAL status closed or carried with waiver
new dated release directory only; README invariants; extended validation.json; existing releases untouched read-only

state rule: no merge into nominal until items 1-23 PASS; STATE.md/RUN_STATUS.md entries only after PASS; 17-component total becomes quoted published total

preconditions_and_blockers: P-ALPHA remains open; it is the standing precondition the gate must close (PM-1); all alpha0p2-template products carry PROVISIONAL/diagnostic status until then

parallel normalization dispatch (fake-fraction provenance / MC-sample identity) is not duplicated here; if it re-identifies the template MC sample, IV-1..IV-5 re-run from primary artifacts
